lines.zh: 我拄着拐，慢慢沿着墙走
lines.en: I walk slowly along the wall with my cane

lines.zh: 院子里石板不平，得看着脚下
lines.en: The flagstones are uneven, I must watch my step

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，走快了会喘
lines.en: At my age, walking fast leaves me short of breath

lines.zh: 我走到门口，回头看屋子
lines.en: I walk to the door and look back at the house
I use the railing on the steps

lines.zh: 拐杖点在地上，一下一下
lines.en: My cane taps the ground, one beat at a time

lines.zh: 我绕着屋子走一圈，就当活动
lines.en: I walk a circle around the house as exercise
My shoulders have grown stooped

lines.zh: 早上空气好，我走远一点
lines.en: The morning air is good, I walk a little farther

lines.zh: 我慢慢走到井边，坐一会儿
lines.en: I walk slowly to the well and sit a while
These shoes have worn through many years

lines.zh: 我走两步，停下来看看天
lines.en: Two steps, then a pause to check the sky

lines.zh: 我绕着院子，把落叶扫成堆
lines.en: I circle the yard sweeping leaves into a pile
I walk and stop, my legs will not agree
I sit on the doorstep in the sun

lines.zh: 手放在膝盖上，什么都不做
lines.en: My hands on my knees, doing nothing
This weather does not suit my bones
I listen to the goings-on in the village
Water drips from the eaves, one beat at a time
I cough twice, as usual

lines.zh: 院子里有只鸟，我不赶它
lines.en: There is a bird in the yard, I do not shoo it
I have spent my whole life here
I roll my sleeve up a little
With the sun like this, I can sit a while
I count the shadows under the eaves
Someone is hammering not far off

lines.zh: 我不太爱说话，可是有人来，我就说
lines.en: I do not talk much, but if someone comes, I do

lines.zh: 我的房子你随时能来看
lines.en: You may look at my house any time

lines.zh: 你来了，站在门口做什么
lines.en: You are here, why stand in the doorway
My yard does not often have visitors

lines.zh: 你的鞋上有泥，赶了远路
lines.en: Mud on your shoes, you came a long way
Come in, the door is not locked

lines.zh: 我这屋子小，可还能住人
lines.en: My house is small, but it can still hold a person

lines.zh: 我仰起脸，颈子咯了一声。
lines.en: I tip my face up and my neck clicks.
If you need a road, I will point it out
Sit down, do not stand
I have lived in this stretch a long while
You look young, you can work

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，见的人多了
lines.en: At my age, I have seen a great many people

lines.zh: 你笑起来像我以前一个邻居
lines.en: Your laugh reminds me of a neighbor I once had
Wind outside, close the door behind you

lines.zh: 我不缺什么，只缺人说话
lines.en: I lack nothing but someone to talk to

lines.zh: 你站那儿吧，我不请你进来
lines.en: Stand there, I am not inviting you in

lines.zh: 有话就说，风从门口灌进来
lines.en: Out with it, the wind is coming in the door
These bones cannot take much
I step back and catch the door
I cough twice, my chest tight
You would strike someone like me
I sit down to recover
The spot is slowly turning blue
I grit my teeth and say nothing

lines.zh: 年轻的时候这点不算什么
lines.en: When I was young this was nothing
I steady myself on the wall
I will swallow this
Let me see what you brought
I am not fond of that
Put it on the table, I will eat later
You need not bring anything
I am not particular, I eat anything
Do not shake, I am not going to eat you
One bowl is about right
Some tea would be nice
When I was young I ate more than this

lines.zh: 你留着自个儿吃吧，我不饿
lines.en: Keep it for yourself, I am not hungry
You bumped into me, slow down
These bones cannot take a knock
I put a hand on the wall
You walk looking only ahead
The door is only this wide, why crowd
That moved me half a step

lines.zh: 你年轻，力气大，别用在我身上
lines.en: You are young and strong, do not spend it on me
I am steady, you may go

lines.zh: 院子里地方大，别贴着墙走
lines.en: The yard has room, do not hug the wall

lines.zh: 再撞，我这拐杖可不客气
lines.en: Bump me again and this cane will not be polite

lines.zh: 我这样的人，一个人过了半辈子
lines.en: Someone like me has lived half a life alone
This house has only one chair
I am old, I do not bring that up

lines.zh: 你要进来坐就坐，别说别的
lines.en: Come in and sit, say nothing else
The fire in the stove has just gone out

lines.zh: 我这儿清静，适合一个人
lines.en: It is quiet here, good for one

lines.zh: 你说的这些，我年轻时也不懂
lines.en: Things like that I did not understand when young either
This leg of mine is not good
Someone is calling you outside
Drink your tea first
I cannot bend, pick it up for me

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，八成是没用的
lines.en: What falls to the ground is usually useless
I nudge it with the cane
What use could this have
Put it in that chest

lines.zh: 我年轻的时候也捡这些东西
lines.en: I picked up things like this when I was young
My eyes are poor, I cannot see it
Keep hold of it, do not lose it

lines.zh: 这院子里的东西都有主
lines.en: Everything in this yard belongs to someone
Put it back where it was, that is right
The gate opened, someone is coming in
My yard gets a lot of idle visitors
You stand in the door like someone not passing through

lines.zh: 我不怕人，我活了这么久
lines.en: I do not fear people, not after all these years
I set the cane aside
Footsteps outside the wall

lines.zh: 你要是不怀好意，就直说
lines.en: If you mean ill, say it plainly
This house cannot take much rough handling
The village knows me

lines.zh: 你往那边站，我看得清你
lines.en: Stand there, I can see you clearly

lines.zh: 我的眼没离开过你的手。
lines.en: My eyes have not left your hands.
You are walking about my yard
There is nowhere to hide a person in this yard

lines.zh: 我在门口坐着，谁也过不去
lines.en: I sit in the doorway, nobody passes
At my age, I do not say much

lines.zh: 你越走越慢，是在想什么
lines.en: You slow down more each step, what are you thinking
That hoe in the corner is mine
My shadow is on the window
The yard is not large, I hear it all
You have stood by the door a long while
I block with the cane

lines.zh: 你别逼我，我年轻时也打过架
lines.en: Do not push me, I fought when I was young
That landed on your wrist
I only push you once

lines.zh: 你退出去，这院子不欢迎你
lines.en: Get out, this yard does not welcome you
My palm is hard
You stepped on my shoe

lines.zh: 我力气不大，可我知道打哪儿
lines.en: I am not strong, but I know where to hit
My cane stays raised; I do not step in.
That cane landed behind your knee.

lines.zh: 我搬进来的时候，屋子还空着
lines.en: The house was empty when I moved in

lines.zh: 我在门槛上坐着，看着路
lines.en: I sit on the doorstep watching the road

lines.zh: 这间屋子有窗户，有屋顶
lines.en: This house has a window and a roof
I have arranged the furniture
I hung the sign myself
The yard is swept, fairly clean

lines.zh: 我年纪大了，还是有个家好
lines.en: Old as I am, it is good to have a home
A lamp is lit inside
I wait at the door for you to speak
This stretch has a resident now
The fire stings this old skin

lines.zh: 我摔在石板上，半天没动
lines.en: I fell on the flagstones and lay a while
Water went down the wrong way, I coughed hard
The blast left me half deaf for a while
An arrow bit into my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股劲儿让我手脚发凉
lines.en: That force left my hands and feet cold
Two days hungry, my head is light
The lightning was close and my legs gave

lines.zh: 这里没有地面，脚踩不着
lines.en: No ground here to put my feet on
